evidence: Adds a new GitHub Actions CI workflow in .github/workflows/code-signing-certificate.yml and has the Windows label.
rationale: Automates Windows code signing certificate expiry checks to prevent release delays on unexpected or expedited releases. Fanquake notes that certs 'always need to work (particularly in the case of expedited releases)' and automation prevents relying on manual checks or RC dry-runs, providing real preventive value while remaining reasonably deferrable.
